subject: Request: temporary quota uplift for product launch — pricing & commit path
messages:
From: Ella Brooks <ella@fintechco.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Quick: temporary quota bump for launch next week

Hi Rishi,

We have a product launch scheduled for 2027-01-05 and traffic models show a ~2.5x spike in inference volume for roughly 2–3 weeks post-launch. Can Redwood do a temporary quota uplift (token throughput and higher rate-limit) while we ramp?

Specific asks:
- Short-term uplift: 2x committed quota for 3 weeks starting 2027-01-05
- What will overrun billing look like (pro-rata? capped?)
- Any possibility of a launch credit or discount if we move to an annual reserved commit after launch?

I've attached a short launch plan and last 4 weeks of usage.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min call if that's easier.

Ella Brooks
Head of Platform Ops, FintechCo
ella@fintechco.com
[Attachment: FA-Launch-Plan.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: fintechco-weekly-usage.csv (text/csv)]

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: Ella Brooks <ella@fintechco.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-20T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick: temporary quota bump for launch next week

Hi Ella — thanks for the details and the attachments. Congrats on the launch!

Short answer: yes, we can provide a temporary uplift and offer a structured path that ties a launch credit to a committed migration. Proposed outline: 

1) Temporary uplift: provisional 2x quota (throughput + rate-limit bump) for up to 3 weeks starting 2027-01-05. We can enable immediately and lock the window in the console.

2) Billing for overrun: overrun will be billed pro-rata daily at the incremental per-token rate. For this uplift we can cap incremental billing to 1.25x your current unit rate (i.e., we will not bill at full overrun list price) for the duration of the uplift if you sign a short amendment.

3) Launch credit & commit incentive: if FintechCo agrees to convert to an annual reserved commit within 30 days after launch, we can provide a one-time launch credit up to $10,000 applied to first invoice and a 15% discount on incremental usage above the commit for the first quarter.

Next steps: I’ll loop in finance and legal so we can get an amendment in DocuSign. If you want, we can do a 20-min call tomorrow to confirm numbers.

Rishi
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

Ask: approval to offer the $10k credit and the 15% incentive. Finance needs to confirm how we apply the credit and whether the billing cap is acceptable. Legal will need to sign a short amendment but I can use our standard short-term uplift template.

Risks: limited — short window, predictable uplift. I think it's a good expansion motion.

Thoughts?

Rishi

Quick take: agree to the uplift and the incentive structure, but prefer 
- tighten the launch credit to $7,500 (instead of $10k), 
- cap uplift window at 3 weeks (agree), and
- require a signed LOI/intent to commit before we grant the capped incremental price.

Ben

Date: 2026-12-20T11:05:00-08:00

Agree with Ben. Operational suggestions:
- Use our short-term uplift amendment and include an explicit rollback date (2027-01-26).
- Add a clause that any usage above the uplift window that persists >14 days will trigger a re-eval for Dedicated/reserved pricing automatically (protects the customer and us).
- Let's also offer a one-time operational credit of $2,500 (applied to first invoice) in addition to the discounted incremental pricing if they sign the annual commit — makes the math friendlier. Total potential credits then $10k -> we can present it as $7,500 launch credit + $2,500 ops credit tied to commit.

Marissa
Head of Customer Growth, Redwood Inference

Hi Ella — thanks for the patience. Quick update and formal proposal below: 

Proposal summary (final for your review):
- Temporary uplift: 2x committed quota for 3 weeks (2027-01-05 to 2027-01-26).
- Overrun billing: pro-rata daily billing for incremental tokens, capped at 1.25x current per-token unit price for the uplift window.
- Credits & incentives: 
  • Launch credit: $7,500 applied to first invoice after uplift window.
  • Ops credit: $2,500 one-time credit applied only if FintechCo signs a 12-month reserved commit within 30 days after uplift window.
  • Additional: 15% discounted incremental rate above the commit for first quarter after commit.
- Requirements: signed LOI/intent to commit (simple one-page) before uplift activation and DocuSign amendment to formalize billing terms.

I've attached the short amendment template. If that works I can have legal/finance route the DocuSign today and enable the uplift once we receive the signed LOI.

Would you like a 20-min call to go over the numbers tomorrow?

Best,
Rishi
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
